text: Debit and credit cards issued on demo accounts can be blocked instantly by the customer through this assistant.

A blocked card cannot be unblocked automatically for security reasons if it was blocked due to a reported loss or theft — those cases require a replacement card, which takes 5-7 business days to arrive.
Cards that have expired cannot be blocked or unblocked; they must be replaced.
There is no fee for blocking a card.
Unblocking a card that was blocked by the customer voluntarily is free and instant.
There is no monthly maintenance fee for savings accounts that maintain the minimum balance requirement.
Falling below the minimum balance attracts a fee of ₹250 per quarter.
ATM withdrawals are free for the first 5 transactions per month at any bank's ATM; each transaction after that is charged ₹20.
There is no fee for online fund transfers (NEFT/IMPS) initiated through official banking channels.
EMI payments are due on the date shown in the loan summary each month.
A missed EMI payment may attract a late fee of ₹500 and can affect the customer's credit score.
Foreclosure (early repayment) of a personal loan is allowed after 12 months from disbursement, subject to a foreclosure charge of 2% of the outstanding principal.
Home loans can be foreclosed at any time without a foreclosure charge, in line with regulatory guidelines for floating-rate loans.
The minimum balance requirement for the demo savings account is ₹10,000.
Fees and policies are subject to the customer agreement.
Customers can dispute a transaction they do not recognize within 60 days of the transaction date.
Disputed amounts are reviewed within 3-7 business days.
If the dispute is upheld, the amount is refunded to the original account; if declined, the customer is notified with the reason.
Completed transactions cannot be cancelled or reversed directly by the customer through this assistant — they must be raised as a dispute for investigation.
